pending_interview.category: System design (ML/AI-specific) — RAG at scale, eval pipeline design, recommendation systems, agent platforms, feature store design
pending_interview.question: You are designing a retrieval-augmented generation system — that is, a system where a language model answers questions by first searching a large document store and pulling in relevant chunks of text before generating its response — for a company with 10 million internal documents that are updated daily. Walk through the full architecture: how you index the documents, how you handle updates so the index stays fresh, how you retrieve the right chunks at query time, and how you would evaluate whether the system is actually returning good answers. What breaks first at this scale, and how do you design around it?
